title: Unstressed total root-uptake finite-volume accounting preflight
purpose: Verify that current SWAP F-CI31 and literature-bound FMC can remove the same prescribed unstressed transpiration water depth with explicit mass closure, without asserting spatial sink equivalence or authorizing a root-active FMC trajectory.

authority.FMC_process_authority: Ogden et al. 2015 doi:10.1002/2015WR017126 right-most/wettest-bin root-zone withdrawal

synthetic_state.rationale: Bin-aligned wet state selected before execution; pressure head is far wetter than the frozen PTRA=0.4 critical Feddes threshold hlim3=-500 cm.

SWAP_route.execution: Compile and execute the current F-CI31 root-uptake process/binding on a committed uniform wet state; do not reimplement Feddes for the authoritative SWAP result.

FMC_route.state_interpretation: Uniform bin-aligned root-zone inventory with all moisture increments through bin 170 present over 30 cm; no composite front/slug/GW geometry is evolved.
FMC_route.withdrawal_rule: Remove the 10-s total uptake demand from the right-most water-containing bin within the root zone.
FMC_route.post_withdrawal_requirement: right-most-bin occupied root-zone length remains positive and all finite-volume inventories remain nonnegative
FMC_route.explicit_nonclaim: This accounting operation is not a native composite FMC trajectory update.

gates: current SWAP root-uptake source blob equals the frozen D27 source identity
SWAP compiled route returns status OK and actual uptake 0.4 cm/day
SWAP sink rates are [0.04,0.18,0.18] cm/day on the three rooted nodes and sum to 0.4 cm/day
selected B01 bin-170 pressure head is finite and > hlim3=-500 cm
FMC right-most-bin finite-volume capacity exceeds 10-s uptake demand
FMC root-zone storage decrement and whole-column storage decrement equal removed water depth within 1e-14 cm
SWAP and FMC total uptake depths agree within floating-point tolerance
spatial extraction structures are explicitly reported non-equivalent

decision_logic.if_positive: Close unstressed accounting only. Native FMC root-active trajectory remains held until composite-state withdrawal/update semantics are bound to the external implementation oracle or equivalent authority.
decision_logic.if_negative: Do not proceed with root-active FMC research.
